info.description: State-of-the-art, open-weight, general-purpose multimodal model with a granular Mixture-of-Experts architecture. The model page lists API names mistral-large-4 and mistral-large-4-0, status Public Preview, and release date 2026-10-06. On 2026-10-29 Mistral released the weights of this same model. The model card says about 1T total parameters, 49B active per token, and 52B including embeddings and output layers; the model page says 1.05T total and 52B active. Context length is written as 1M, and the model card's local config sets max_context_length to 1048576. Input is text and image, and output is text. reasoning_effort accepts low, medium, or high, and high is the default; low replaces the earlier none mode. Weights are on Hugging Face as mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B, and a separate NVFP4 checkpoint is mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B-NVFP4. That card refers to an FP8 checkpoint, but the public model list has no separate FP8 repository. The license is the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License, a modified MIT license. The API price is $0.70 per 1M input tokens, $0.07 cached input, and $2.10 output.

zh.description: 最先进的开放权重通用多模态模型，采用细粒度混合专家（Mixture-of-Experts）架构。模型页列出的 API 名称是 mistral-large-4 和 mistral-large-4-0，状态为 Public Preview，发布日为 2026-10-06。2026-10-29，Mistral 发布了同一模型的权重。模型卡写总参数约 1T，每 token 激活 49B，算上嵌入和输出层为 52B；模型页写总参数 1.05T、激活 52B。上下文写成 1M，模型卡的本地配置把 max_context_length 设为 1048576。输入为文本和图像，输出为文本。reasoning_effort 可取 low、medium 或 high，默认 high；low 取代了先前的 none。权重在 Hugging Face 的 mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B，另有 NVFP4 检查点 mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B-NVFP4。该卡提到 FP8 检查点，但公开模型列表里没有单独的 FP8 仓库。许可证是 Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License，即修改版 MIT。API 价格为输入每百万 tokens 0.70 美元、缓存输入 0.07 美元、输出 2.10 美元。
